META-INF/neoforge.mods.toml.text:
modLoader="javafml"
loaderVersion="[4,)"
license="LGPLv3"
issueTrackerURL="https://github.com/yungnickyoung/YUNGs-Better-Jungle-Temples/issues"

[[mods]]
    modId="betterjungletemples"
    version="1.21.1-NeoForge-3.1.2"
    displayName="YUNG's Better Jungle Temples"
    credits="Thanks so much to all my patrons!"

    type="required"
    versionRange="[1.21, 1.22)"

[[dependencies.betterjungletemples]]
    modId="neoforge"

    versionRange="[21.0.0,)"

    modId="yungsapi"
    versionRange="[1.21.1-NeoForge-5.1.3,)"
    type="required"
    ordering="NONE"

[[mixins]]
    config = "betterjungletemples.mixins.json"
